answer: Falcon Registration Cost: each identity must post a ferrous marker (a traceable hardware token) that is forfeited on first dispute. Registration cost is trivial, but the marker's replacement price rises with each identity an operator controls, since disputed markers get blacklisted. An attacker running N sybils pays replacement costs that grow with N, so the marginal cost curves upward. A nectar bonus refunds honest markers after a clean period, keeping honest costs near zero while sybil cost stays high.
